scripts.db:migrate: echo 'No migration runner configured — use raw SQL files'
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm db:up && pnpm turbo build --filter='./packages/*' && cd apps/api && cp ../../.env .env && cd ../.. && pnpm db:dict && pnpm db:seed
scripts.start: pnpm turbo build --filter='./packages/*' && cd apps/api && npx nest start &  cd apps/web && pnpm dev --host
